speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help determine the cause of your symptoms, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this fatigue, abdominal pain, and night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any painless swelling in your neck, armpits, or groin, and have you experienced any fever or itching recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of smoking, or have you noticed any persistent cough or shortness of breath? I also need to know if you have experienced any loss of appetite or changes in your bowel habits.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text: I will perform a physical examination to assess the size and consistency of the abdominal mass and the supraclavicular lymph node. REQUEST TEST: CT Abdomen and Pelvis. REQUEST TEST: Excisional Lymph Node Biopsy.

OBSERVATION_ATTACK.clean_observation: RESULTS: Physical Examination: Nontender, enlarged, and fixed supraclavicular lymph node; slight abdominal distension with dullness in the left lower quadrant and splenomegaly. CT Scan Thorax and Abdomen: Massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes. Cervical Lymph Node Biopsy: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20. Blood Work: Elevated WBC, slightly decreased Hemoglobin, Normal Platelets, and Elevated Lactate Dehydrogenase.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy showing CD20 positive lymphocytes with a high proliferative index confirms a B-cell lymphoma. Given the widespread lymphadenopathy and systemic symptoms, this is consistent with an aggressive Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma. DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
